## Problem and expected behavior

Describe the observed failure and the expected behavior. Link the relevant
contract, original task or implementation when known.

## Reproduction and environment

Provide minimal steps using synthetic data, the source version/commit, native
Windows, PowerShell, Classic Outlook and OpenCode versions as applicable. Include
only sanitized error messages; do not attach live mail, addresses, mailbox/item
IDs, credentials or raw query results.

## Scope and exclusions

Identify affected behavior/files and what remains out of scope. Keep MailLens
within its approved Windows/OpenCode, Classic Outlook and read-only boundary.

## Dependencies and related reports

Link prerequisites, related issues or implementations; write "None known" when
appropriate. Explain any compatibility, concurrency or rollback implications.

## Acceptance and verification evidence

- [ ] Describe the corrected observable behavior and a meaningful assertion.

Record exact commands/scenarios, expected and actual results, environment, failed
or skipped checks and sanitized evidence links. Distinguish synthetic tests from
real Windows/Outlook verification.
